newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi 100-share index rises above 1,600 points.
newsitem.headline: Karachi 100-share index rises above 1,600 points.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose above the psychological barrier of 1,600 points on Tuesday's settlement day on speculative buying before Friday's 1997/98 (July-June) budget, dealers said.
The index rose on buying of blue chips as trading volume surged in a pre-budget rally, dealers said.
The 10-rupee stock of Hub Power Company Ltd, heavily weighted in the 100-share index, jumped 0.90 rupee to 41.40 at 11.55 a.m. (06.55 GMT).
There was also heavy trading in ICI Pakistan, which rose 0.10 rupee to 25.23.
